SEARCH
Package domain

Class Match

java.lang.Object
domain.Match
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Match extends Object implements Serializable
A match between two players. It creates everything on the field and coordinates each tick: the players act, the physics library moves everything and the goals are checked. When it ends is decided by its MatchType.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Elian Ibarra, Oscar Poveda

  • Constructor Details

    • Match

      public Match(GameCharacter leftCharacter, Stats leftStats, PlayerController leftController, GameCharacter rightCharacter, Stats rightStats, PlayerController rightController, MatchType type, String resolution, BallSkin skin, String stadiumName) throws DOPOSoccerException
      Creates a match ready to start: 0 - 0, empty power bars, full life and the ball over the center.
      Parameters:
      leftCharacter - character of the left player
      leftStats - stats of the left player
      leftController - who controls the left player
      rightCharacter - character of the right player
      rightStats - stats of the right player
      rightController - who controls the right player
      type - rule to end the match
      resolution - "SMALL", "MEDIUM" or "LARGE"
      skin - ball chosen to play
      stadiumName - stadium where it is played ("default", "rain"...)
      Throws:
      DOPOSoccerException - UNKNOWN_RESOLUTION if the resolution is not valid

  • Method Details

    • kickOff

      public void kickOff()
      Puts the players at their places and drops the ball from the center.

    • update

      public void update(double dt)
      Advances the match one tick: players act and update, fake balls count down, the physics library moves everything and the goals are checked. It does nothing once the match is finished.
      Parameters:
      dt - elapsed time, in seconds

    • onBallTouch

      public void onBallTouch(Player p)
      A player touched the ball. The physics calls it, and also a kick with the aura on. If the player has the aura, its power shot comes out. If the ball carries a power shot of the rival, the player takes its damage (base damage times the shooter's kick multiplier) and its effect.
      Parameters:
      p - the player that touched the ball

    • onBallHitsBorder

      public void onBallHitsBorder()
      The ball hit a wall, the ceiling or a crossbar: a power shot that was on its way is over. The physics calls it.

      Parameters:

      duration - seconds they last
